key: Sorry, residents only past this area.
en: Sorry, residents only past this area.
ja: すみません、この先は住民の方のみとなっております。

key: Lord, after being on the streets for so long when this place was destroyed before...
en: Lord, after being on the streets for so long when this place was destroyed before...
ja: ああ、この場所が破壊されてから長いこと路上暮らしをしていた身としては……

key: To be back here now is surreal.
en: To be back here now is surreal.
ja: 今こうしてここに戻ってこられるなんて、現実とは思えない。

key: LILLIN: Hmm? Were you looking for me?
en: LILLIN: Hmm? Were you looking for me?
ja: リリン: ん?あたしを探してた?

key: Eh? You have Loudred?
en: Eh? You have Loudred?
ja: え?ドゴームを持ってるの?

key: After all this time...
en: After all this time...
ja: こんなに時間が経ってから……

key: ...my peace has finally come to an end.
en: ...my peace has finally come to an end.
ja: ……あたしの平穏、ついに終わっちゃったか。

key: Do I really have to take it back?
en: Do I really have to take it back?
ja: 本当にあれ、引き取らなきゃダメ?

key: Like, really? I was hoping to just leave it in the Day Care forever.
en: Like, really? I was hoping to just leave it in the Day Care forever.
ja: マジで?育て屋にずっと預けておくつもりだったのに。

key: I'm serious! It's sooo hard to sleep with this thing around!
en: I'm serious! It's sooo hard to sleep with this thing around!
ja: 冗談じゃなくて!あれがいるとマジで眠れないんだから!

key: I've only just remembered what it's like to even have dreams at night!
en: I've only just remembered what it's like to even have dreams at night!
ja: 夜に夢を見るのがどんな感じだったか、やっと思い出せたところだったのに!

key: Forget it! I'm not taking it back! You can't make me!
en: Forget it! I'm not taking it back! You can't make me!
ja: もういい!引き取らない!無理強いはできないよ!

key: LILLIN: Okay, fine, I'll take it back.
en: LILLIN: Okay, fine, I'll take it back.
ja: リリン: はいはい、わかった、引き取るよ。

key: LILLIN: Hey! What are you trying to pull here? That's not my Loudred.
en: LILLIN: Hey! What are you trying to pull here? That's not my Loudred.
ja: リリン: ちょっと!何のつもり?それ、あたしのドゴームじゃないんだけど。

key: Though getting another Pokémon would be nice too, I guess.
en: Though getting another Pokémon would be nice too, I guess.
ja: まあ別のポケモンをもらえるのも悪くないか。

key: LILLIN: Goodbye, fair sleep.
en: LILLIN: Goodbye, fair sleep.
ja: リリン: さようなら、心地よい眠り。

key: Goodbye, sweet dreams.
en: Goodbye, sweet dreams.
ja: さようなら、甘い夢。

key: I will remember you fondly from my renewed insomnia-driven delirium.
en: I will remember you fondly from my renewed insomnia-driven delirium.
ja: 不眠でぼんやりする夜が戻ってきても、あなたのことを懐かしく思い出すからね。

key: LILLIN: I need like, a Jigglypuff or something to cancel out this racket-maker here.
en: LILLIN: I need like, a Jigglypuff or something to cancel out this racket-maker here.
ja: リリン: このやかまし製造機を打ち消すために、プリンかなんかが必要なんだよね。

key: Or to just KO the sucker...
en: Or to just KO the sucker...
ja: もしくはあいつをKOしてくれるやつが……

key: Eh? What do you mean you have a Jigglypuff for me too?
en: Eh? What do you mean you have a Jigglypuff for me too?
ja: え?あたしにもプリンをくれるってどういうこと?

key: So I just need to hold it for someone? Hm...
en: So I just need to hold it for someone? Hm...
ja: つまり、誰かのために預かっとくだけでいいの?うーん……

key: LILLIN: Huh? Hey, don't tease me like this!
en: LILLIN: Huh? Hey, don't tease me like this!
ja: リリン: え?ちょっと、からかわないでよ!

key: LILLIN: Mwhahaha!
en: LILLIN: Mwhahaha!
ja: リリン: ふふふふ!

key: Jigglypuff is now mine!
en: Jigglypuff is now mine!
ja: プリンはもうあたしのもの!

key: All the days and all the nights of precious sleep that I haven't even been able to dream of-- they're mine! Mine!
en: All the days and all the nights of precious sleep that I haven't even been able to dream of-- they're mine!  Mine!
ja: 今まで夢にも見られなかった、あらゆる日と夜の貴重な眠りが――全部あたしのもの!あたしの!

key: I never agreed to give it back! I refuse! I'm keeping Jigglypuff!
en: I never agreed to give it back! I refuse! I'm keeping Jigglypuff!
ja: 返すなんて一言も言ってない!絶対いや!プリンはもらっとく!

key: Okay, I know, that's rude.
en: Okay, I know, that's rude.
ja: わかってるよ、失礼だってことくらい。

key: But I'm keeping it as collateral until YOU do something about this Loudred!
en: But I'm keeping it as collateral until YOU do something about this Loudred!
ja: でもこのドゴームの件をあんたがどうにかしてくれるまで、これは担保として預からせてもらう。

key: I don't mean take it away, but just find some way I can tolerate its screeching all night.
en: I don't mean take it away, but just find some way I can tolerate its screeching all night.
ja: 取り上げるつもりはないけど、一晩中あの鳴き声に耐えられる方法をとにかく見つけてよ。

key: You got that? I don't care if it's ultra-quality earplugs, headphones, or something else! Just, fix it!
en: You got that? I don't care if it's ultra-quality earplugs, headphones, or something else! Just, fix it!
ja: わかった?超高性能な耳栓でもヘッドホンでも何でもいいから!とにかく何とかして!

key: I won't give Jigglypuff to its real owner until you do!
en: I won't give Jigglypuff to its real owner until you do!
ja: あんたがそうしてくれるまで、プリンは本当の持ち主に返さないから!

key: LILLIN: I'm keeping Jigglypuff as collateral until YOU do something about this Loudred!
en: LILLIN: I'm keeping Jigglypuff as collateral until YOU do something about this Loudred!
ja: リリン: このドゴームの件をあんたがどうにかしてくれるまで、プリンは担保として預からせてもらう。

key: \PN handed over the Headphones.
en: \PN handed over the Headphones.
ja: \PNはヘッドホンを渡した。

key: LILLIN: You know, I was just joking.
en: LILLIN: You know, I was just joking.
ja: リリン: あのさ、あれは冗談だったんだよ。

key: I wouldn't actually steal a Pokémon, especially after having mine stolen.
en: I wouldn't actually steal a Pokémon, especially after having mine stolen.
ja: 本当にポケモンを盗んだりしないって。特に自分のポケモンが盗まれた後だし。

key: But hey, I'll take these anyway. Let me try them on.
en: But hey, I'll take these anyway. Let me try them on.
ja: でもまあ、これはもらっとく。ちょっとつけてみるね。

key: Go ahead and say something.
en: Go ahead and say something.
ja: 何か話してみて。

key: LILLIN: Yeah, I don't have a clue what you just said.
en: LILLIN: Yeah, I don't have a clue what you just said.
ja: リリン: うん、今なんて言ったのか全然わかんなかった。

key: These are perfect. Thank you so much!
en: These are perfect. Thank you so much!
ja: 完璧だよ。本当にありがとう!

key: You can tell that whoever-guy to come get his Jigglypuff whenever he wants.
en: You can tell that whoever-guy to come get his Jigglypuff whenever he wants.
ja: その誰か知らないけど、いつでもドゴームを取りに来ていいって伝えといて。

key: No jokes this time.
en: No jokes this time.
ja: 今度は冗談抜きでね。

key: LILLIN: You can tell that whoever-guy to come get his Jigglypuff whenever he wants.
en: LILLIN: You can tell that whoever-guy to come get his Jigglypuff whenever he wants.
ja: リリン: その誰か知らないけど、いつでもドゴームを取りに来ていいって伝えといて。

key: LILLIN: Thanks for all your help! I know I was kind of a pain.
en: LILLIN: Thanks for all your help! I know I was kind of a pain.
ja: リリン: 色々手伝ってくれてありがとう!ちょっと面倒だったよね。

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 施錠されている。

key: ???: Ah, ah, ah...
en: ???: Ah, ah, ah...
ja: ???: ああ、ああ、ああ……

key: An unexpected guest. How unfortunate...
en: An unexpected guest. How unfortunate...
ja: 思いがけないお客様。何とも不運なことです……

key: I mean no disrespect. I'm just at a bit of a loss.
en: I mean no disrespect. I'm just at a bit of a loss.
ja: 失礼のつもりはありません。ただ少々困惑しているだけで。

key: Have we met?
en: Have we met?
ja: お会いしたことがありましたか?

key: No, no, probably not. Right?
en: No, no, probably not. Right?
ja: いいえ、いいえ、おそらくないでしょう。そうですよね?

key: I will be known as the Miracle Eye Medium, Miss Direction.
en: I will be known as the Miracle Eye Medium, Miss Direction.
ja: 私は「奇跡の目の霊媒師」、ミス・ディレクションとして知られる者です。

key: Where other people are born with the ability to know things that happened in the past, I am born with the ability to know things that will happen in the future.
en: Where other people are born with the ability to know things that happened in the past, I am born with the ability to know things that will happen in the future.
ja: 他の人々が過去に起きたことを知る力を持って生まれるのに対し、私はこれから起きることを知る力を持って生まれました。

key: But for those of us who can see the future, the past and present are a mystery.
en: But for those of us who can see the future, the past and present are a mystery.
ja: ですが、未来を見通せる私たちにとっては、過去と現在こそが謎なのです。

key: Nonetheless, I seem to have been in somewhat of a crisis.
en: Nonetheless, I seem to have been in somewhat of a crisis.
ja: とはいえ、どうやら私は今、ちょっとした危機に陥っているようです。

key: My fortune has gone missing.
en: My fortune has gone missing.
ja: 私の「占い」が行方不明になってしまったのです。

key: Without it, I can see neither the future nor the past.
en: Without it, I can see neither the future nor the past.
ja: それがなければ、未来も過去も見ることができません。

key: Until I get my fortune back, I am trapped in an evanescent present.
en: Until I get my fortune back, I am trapped in an evanescent present.
ja: 占いを取り戻すまで、私ははかい「今」に閉じ込められたままなのです。

key: But that is why you are here, right?
en: But that is why you are here, right?
ja: でも、それがあなたがここにいる理由なのでしょう?

key: You are here to give me that Crystal Ball.
en: You are here to give me that Crystal Ball.
ja: あなたは私にその水晶玉を渡すためにここにいるのですから。

key: \PN handed over the Crystal Ball.
en: \PN handed over the Crystal Ball.
ja: \PNはすいしょうだまを渡した。

key: MISS DIRECTION: Ah, ah, ah~
en: MISS DIRECTION: Ah, ah, ah~
ja: ミス・ディレクション: ああ、ああ、ああ～

key: I feel like myself again.
en: I feel like myself again.
ja: 自分自身を取り戻した気分です。

key: This is the fortune of which I have spoken.
en: This is the fortune of which I have spoken.
ja: これこそ、私がお話ししていた占いです。

key: Ah? Two goons are discussing how to get at my treasure.
en: Ah? Two goons are discussing how to get at my treasure.
ja: あら?二人組の悪党が、私の宝をどう狙うか話し合っていますね。

key: How naive. I will give them a warm welcome.
en: How naive. I will give them a warm welcome.
ja: なんて浅はかな。温かく歓迎して差し上げましょう。

key: And from here... I see.
en: And from here... I see.
ja: そしてここから……見えますね。

key: Then I'm supposed to give you this.
en: Then I'm supposed to give you this.
ja: では、これをあなたにお渡ししましょう。

key: MISS DIRECTION: When you need a reading, please feel free to come ask for one.
en: MISS DIRECTION: When you need a reading, please feel free to come ask for one.
ja: ミス・ディレクション: 占いが必要になったら、いつでも聞きに来てください。

key: As thanks for your help, it will be at no cost to you.
en: As thanks for your help, it will be at no cost to you.
ja: 助けていただいたお礼として、料金はいただきません。

key: But I can tell already... you may not like the outcome.
en: But I can tell already... you may not like the outcome.
ja: でも、もう分かっているのです……あなたはその結果を気に入らないかもしれません。

key: MISS DIRECTION: Of course, you're interested in your future as well.
en: MISS DIRECTION: Of course, you're interested in your future as well.
ja: ミス・ディレクション: もちろん、あなたも自分の未来に興味がおありでしょう。

key: It is normal to seek what one does not have.
en: It is normal to seek what one does not have.
ja: 持っていないものを求めるのは自然なことです。

key: That is why I entertain myself with all of these history books, which I will doubtlessly forget about.
en: That is why I entertain myself with all of these history books, which I will doubtlessly forget about.
ja: だからこそ私は、いずれ忘れてしまうであろうこれらの歴史書で自分を楽しませているのです。

key: In any case, would you like to hear your fortune now?
en: In any case, would you like to hear your fortune now?
ja: ともあれ、今、あなたの運勢を聞いてみたいですか?

key: MISS DIRECTION: Very well. I will look through my Crystal Ball again.
en: MISS DIRECTION: Very well. I will look through my Crystal Ball again.
ja: ミス・ディレクション: よろしいでしょう。もう一度、水晶玉を通して見てみます。

key: I would hope that what I see is different this time, as it sometimes is,
en: I would hope that what I see is different this time, as it sometimes is,
ja: 見えるものが、時々そうであるように今回は違っていればいいのですが、

key: But I know already that it is not.
en: But I know already that it is not.
ja: 今回もそうではないと、私はすでに分かっています。

key: Ah, ah, ah~
en: Ah, ah, ah~
ja: ああ、ああ、ああ～

key: What I see in your future...
en: What I see in your future...
ja: あなたの未来に見えるもの……

key: ...is hard for me to understand.
en: ...is hard for me to understand.
ja: ……それは私にも理解しがたいものです。

key: It is a future where you do not exist.
en: It is a future where you do not exist.
ja: それは、あなたが存在しない未来です。

key: It is a future where there were never any traces of you existing.
en: It is a future where there were never any traces of you existing.
ja: あなたが存在した痕跡すら一切ない未来です。

key: This is strange, because you are the only one I will ever see such a thing for.
en: This is strange, because you are the only one I will ever see such a thing for.
ja: 不思議なことに、私がこのようなものを見るのは、あなたに対してだけなのです。

key: But let me tell you about this world you are not in.
en: But let me tell you about this world you are not in.
ja: ですが、あなたのいないこの世界について、お話ししましょう。

key: During a time that this ward is still garnished with a deadly flora,
en: During a time that this ward is still garnished with a deadly flora,
ja: この区がまだ死をもたらす植物に覆われていた時代に、

key: A boy with a beaded tooth necklace steps forward to destroy the chaos.
en: A boy with a beaded tooth necklace steps forward to destroy the chaos.
ja: ビーズの歯のネックレスをつけた少年が、こんとんを打ち破るために前に進み出ます。

key: He earns friends to fight alongside him.
en: He earns friends to fight alongside him.
ja: 彼は共に戦う友を得ます。

key: A man with spiked bracelets...
en: A man with spiked bracelets...
ja: とがったブレスレットの男……

key: Another with azure hair...
en: Another with azure hair...
ja: もう一人は、青い髪の……

key: A girl blessed with a sleeping star...
en: A girl blessed with a sleeping star...
ja: 眠れる星に祝福された少女……

key: And a taciturn woman in a black and red suit.
en: And a taciturn woman in a black and red suit.
ja: そして、黒と赤のスーツをまとった無口な女……

key: Together, they cut the tainted roots away from this city,
en: Together, they cut the tainted roots away from this city,
ja: 彼らは共に、この街からけがれた根を切り離し、

key: Purge poison from the lake,
en: Purge poison from the lake,
ja: 湖から毒を取り除き、

key: And chase fire from the mountain peaks.
en: And chase fire from the mountain peaks.
ja: 山の頂から炎を追い払います。

key: And then...
en: And then...
ja: そして、その後……

key: The city streets crack,
en: The city streets crack,
ja: 街の通りが裂け、

key: Spiked bracelets splinter in the fissure below.
en: Spiked bracelets splinter in the fissure below.
ja: とがったブレスレットは、その下の裂け目で砕け散ります。

key: Shining armor strikes,
en: Shining armor strikes,
ja: 輝くよろいが振り下ろされ、

key: Azure hair is redyed red.
en: Azure hair is redyed red.
ja: 青い髪は赤く染め直されます。

key: An enemy of his own blood stands before him,
en: An enemy of his own blood stands before him,
ja: 彼自身の血を分けた敵が、彼の前に立ちはだかり、

key: And beaded hope breaks apart upon the tattered stones of a city forced to live up to its name once again.
en: And beaded hope breaks apart upon the tattered stones of a city forced to live up to its name once again.
ja: ビーズの希望は、その名にふさわしくあれと強いられた街の、荒れた石畳の上で砕け散ります。

key: The sleeping star invokes a wish.
en: The sleeping star invokes a wish.
ja: 眠れる星が、願いを呼び起こします。

key: From there, the suited girl disappears.
en: From there, the suited girl disappears.
ja: そこから、スーツの少女は姿を消します。

key: And that future follows shortly after.
en: And that future follows shortly after.
ja: そして、その未来がすぐ後に続くのです。

key: From looking through your time, that is all I can see.
en: From looking through your time, that is all I can see.
ja: あなたの時間をのぞき見て、私に見えるのはそこまでです。

key: I hope that you come to understand it better than I will.
en: I hope that you come to understand it better than I will.
ja: 私よりも、あなたがそれをよく理解できることを願っています。

key: MISS DIRECTION: That is a wise choice.
en: MISS DIRECTION: That is a wise choice.
ja: ミス・ディレクション: それは賢明な選択です。

key: Be well while you can.
en: Be well while you can.
ja: できる限り、お元気で。

key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 34!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 34!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果解説書34を手に入れた!

key: Info on Starlight Arena now available!
en: Info on Starlight Arena now available!
ja: スターライトアリーナの情報が閲覧可能になった!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
